ValidationRule.description: Stages in ForecastCategory "Closed" are 5, 6 and 7. CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date. #20656- Making it applicable for all record types
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(CloseDate), CloseDate > TODAY(), ISPICKVAL(ForecastCategoryName , "Closed"), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date cannot be a future date in late stage opportunities. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
